topics.label: Implementation attacks
topics.definition: Attacks on how a scheme is implemented rather than on its mathematics: side channels, fault injection, timing, and their countermeasures.
exclude: attacks on the underlying hard problem (use cryptanalysis)
estimates of the quantum computer needed to break RSA or ECC (use quantum-threat)

topics.label: Cryptanalysis
topics.definition: Mathematical attacks on post-quantum or classical schemes and their parameters, including breaks, improved attacks and parameter re-estimates.
include: attacks on PQC candidates or standards
lattice reduction or decoding attack cost
exclude: resource estimates for a quantum computer breaking RSA or ECC (use quantum-threat)

topics.label: Formal analysis
topics.definition: Security proofs, security models and machine-checked verification of schemes, protocols or implementations.
exclude: informal security discussion without a proof or model

topics.label: Protocol integration
topics.definition: How post-quantum algorithms are carried in network and messaging protocols, including hybrid key exchange and signature formats.
exclude: certificate formats and PKI operations (use pki-certificates)

topics.label: PKI and certificates
topics.definition: Certificates, certificate formats and public-key infrastructure operations with post-quantum or hybrid keys.
exclude: transport protocols that only carry certificates (use protocol-integration)

topics.label: HSMs and key management
topics.definition: Hardware security modules, key management systems and key-handling interfaces for post-quantum keys.

topics.label: Entropy and random numbers
topics.definition: Random bit generation: entropy sources, DRBGs, health tests, conditioning and their validation.

topics.label: Migration and crypto agility
topics.definition: Planning and executing the move to post-quantum cryptography: inventory, prioritisation, crypto agility and migration practice.
exclude: binding requirements and deadlines set by governments or regulators (use policy-regulation)

topics.label: Policy and regulation
topics.definition: Government, regulatory and standards-body requirements, guidance and deadlines for post-quantum cryptography.
include: national guidance (e.g. NSA CNSA 2.0, BSI, ANSSI, NCSC)
exclude: the technical content of a standard itself, when no requirement or deadline is stated

topics.label: Performance and benchmarks
topics.definition: Measured speed, size, memory or energy of post-quantum algorithms and implementations, and how they were measured.
include: key, signature and ciphertext sizes in practice
exclude: parameter tables copied from a specification without measurement

topics.label: Domain applications
topics.definition: Post-quantum cryptography applied in a specific industry or application domain.
exclude: documents that only mention a sector in passing
general protocol or PKI work that is not specific to one domain

topics.label: Quantum threat
topics.definition: When and how a cryptographically relevant quantum computer could break today's public-key cryptography: resource estimates, hardware progress and timeline surveys.
include: CRQC resource estimates (qubits, run time) for RSA or ECC
exclude: attacks on post-quantum schemes, classical or quantum (use cryptanalysis)
